rules.sourceText: Prerequisites: Declared SCOM majors or declared SCOM minors only, and SCOM 121 , SCOM 122 or SCOM 123 , and sophomore standing or above. Corequisites: SCOM 240L .
rules.notes: SCOM 121, SCOM 122, and SCOM 123 are alternate versions of the General Education Fundamental Human Communication course; the catalog's "SCOM 121 , SCOM 122 or SCOM 123" means any one of them. The parser cannot tell this list from same-shaped lists such as MATH 470's "MATH 245 , MATH 238 or MATH 300 , and ...", where the first course is required. The declared-major/minor restriction is kept as an unenforced condition.
